notes.title: Network Optimisation
notes.notes:
Major optimisation to networking removing at least 10 times the unneccessary network traffic from before.
You should see a large network performance boost to those on slower networks.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes: Quick bug patching following the new update

notes.title: Steam Lobby Based Networking
notes.notes:
To solve server issues I have introduced steam based lobbies!
This means you can create your own private/ public lobbies and customise game properties (more customisation coming soon) To add to this, you can now also invite/ join via the steam overlay (once past the log in screen)

notes.title: Pig Update
notes.notes:
Welcome to the pig update!
This is our first update since launching to Steam and I have some new stuff for you!

[u][b]Patch Notes[/b][/u]

[b]New Animal[/b]
Welcome the new animal, the pig.
This animal increases your chance to apply slows on hit.

[b]Equipment[/b]
- Boarnade Launcher: This grenade launcher fires grenades that can bounce around before detonating into a field of purple gas that both slows and damages, turning your enemies into pigs.
- Auto-Turret: Yes, you can now place auto turrets, these will automatically target all enemy targets (including farmers) on the same horizontal plane and fire at them over a fair distance. The animal stacks they apply are chosen randomly when the turret is placed.

[b]Items[/b]
- Pegasus Feather: Increased your mid air jump count by 1 per stack.
- Bull's Nose Ring: Transforming an enemy permamently increases your max resistance by 1 per stack.
- Mechanites: Gives a chance for enemies you transform to spawn either a drone or an auto-turret where they transform.

[b]Other[/b]
- Human Essense fills up 25/100 from 33/100 (To make coming back a little harder)
- Reload Indicator to see how far through a reload you are.
- Damage Percentage Indicator to show how much more damage your total transformations are giving you.
- Character Healthbars made slightly larger to make status effect icons easier to see.
- Discord button on main menu.
- Leaderboard reset. (For now still win based but look to do something better soon)
- More emotes (Skins coming real soon too)
